description: This file contains asynchronous functions for fetching image details via HTTP requests using multiple libraries (httpx, aiohttp). It includes test functions to compare the performance of different asynchronous image fetching methods, and a main execution block to run these tests and output comparison statistics.

methods.name: asyncify(func, *args, **kwargs)
methods.description: Executes a function asynchronously in a separate thread.

methods.name: Tuple[str,str] get_image_details(image_url)
methods.description: Fetches image data synchronously using HTTPHandler and returns base64 content and content type.

methods.name: Tuple[str,str] get_image_details_async(image_url)
methods.description: Fetches image data asynchronously using AsyncHTTPHandler and returns base64 content and content type.

methods.name: Tuple[str,str] get_image_details_aio(image_url)
methods.description: Fetches image data asynchronously using aiohttp ClientSession and returns base64 content and content type.

methods.name: list[float] test_asyncified(urls: list[str], iterations: int = 3)
methods.description: Runs multiple iterations of get_image_details in parallel, measures execution times.

methods.name: list[float] test_async_httpx(urls: list[str], iterations: int = 3)
methods.description: Runs multiple iterations of get_image_details_async in parallel, measures execution times.

methods.name: list[float] test_aiohttp(urls: list[str], iterations: int = 3)
methods.description: Runs multiple iterations of get_image_details_aio in parallel, measures execution times.

methods.name: run_comparison()
methods.description: Executes performance tests for all three methods and prints comparison results.

ctags.name: test_aiohttp
ctags.pattern: /^async def test_aiohttp(urls: list[str], iterations: int = 3) -> list[float]:$/

ctags.pattern: /^async def test_async_httpx(urls: list[str], iterations: int = 3) -> list[float]:$/

ctags.pattern: /^async def test_asyncified(urls: list[str], iterations: int = 3) -> list[float]:$/
